summary: Body found below Painted Wall/Serpent Point, Black Canyon; apparent fatal off-route free-solo fall.
notes: Body found July 10; fall date unknown. County Montrose (South Rim area). NPS morning-report entry (dated 2013-07-16) confirms the July 10, 2013 body at the base of a North Rim cliff (unattended vehicle parked on the North Rim overnight), recovered July 11 via helicopter; NPS + Montrose County Sheriff's Office/Medical Examiner investigating.
